subject: Re: Kickoff: CATE - staffing + the distillation recipe
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing: Yusuf 50% (TL - note he's also closing out the caltrain repro track through mid-May, hence the late M1 date). Saoirse 40% on the batch API and checkpoint serving (she rolls up from 20% when BUSTLE M3 wraps). Jorge 60% - see below.

The serving-cost plan is the crux: the pretrained CATE backbone is too heavy to serve at video-library scale, so the M2 answer is distillation into a smaller student. There's no existing recipe to borrow here, so we're scoping and staffing a distillation training recipe from scratch - Jorge owns it at 60%: teacher-student setup, loss schedule, and the ablation grid to find how small the student can go before retrieval quality craters. Rough sizing: 5-6 weeks to a defensible recipe, GPU cost ~30 titan-a100 days for the grid.

Data note: Kinetics/UCF mirrors are already internal (vision team's copies), so no Corpus dependency this window.

Bruno
